description: One call before paying a supplier: validates the IBAN, BIC, VAT (EU or UK) and EIN on the invoice AND cross-checks them against each other and the supplier's country, then returns verdict pay / review / hold with plain-English reasons. Catches the changed-bank-details fraud pattern (e.g. a German supplier asking to be paid into a foreign account), BIC/IBAN country mismatches, unregistered VAT numbers, and (with live=true) a VIES-registered company name that doesn't match the supplier name. Pass whatever the invoice has; only one field is needed.

live.description: Also check the VAT number in the official EU VIES registry

supplier_country.description: ISO country of the supplier as you know it (from your vendor master, not the invoice)

supplier_name.description: Supplier legal name, compared with the VIES-registered name when live=true

vat.description: Supplier VAT ID (EU with country prefix, or GB...)

name: check_invoice_payee
title: Check an invoice payee (pay / review / hold)
